item.title: FDA-cleared AI devices seldom have patient outcome data
item.description: Among 1,357 FDA-authorized AI and machine learning medical devices, only 34 were linked to registered prospective trials.

item.title: Deep-learning model shows high diagnostic accuracy for diabetic macular edema using OCT scans
item.description: Nguyen and colleagues developed and evaluated a deep-learning model for detecting diabetic macular edema using 3D OCT scans. The model achieved high performance.

item.title: Apixaban linked to lower stroke and bleeding rates than warfarin in AF and advanced CKD
item.description: In patients with atrial fibrillation and advanced chronic kidney disease not on dialysis, apixaban was associated with significantly reduced rates of ischemic stroke and bleeding compared with warfarin.
